title: Listening Mini Practice Test
overview: A short Listening practice set. The teacher or app reads each script aloud. Students answer questions about classroom, science, and community topics.

sections.title: Listen and Answer
sections.directions: Listen to each script read aloud. Then answer the question. You may listen one more time if you need to.

items.title: Library Reminder
items.prompt: What does the announcement remind students to do?
items.correct: Correct. The announcement reminds students to return their library books by Friday.
items.hint: Listen for the action word and the day.
items.support: Return means to give the books back.
items.extension: What happens if a book is late?
script: Attention, students. This is a reminder from the library. Please return your library books by Friday so other students can borrow them.

items.title: Bring for the Project
items.prompt: Which materials does the teacher say to bring for the art project?
items.correct: Correct. The teacher lists scissors, glue, and colored paper.
items.hint: Track the list joined with and. A ruler was not mentioned.
items.support: Listen for each item in the list, one at a time.
items.extension: Why are scissors useful for this project?
script: For tomorrow's art project, please bring scissors, glue, and colored paper. You will not need a ruler.

items.title: Plant Steps
items.prompt: Put the steps for planting a seed in the order the teacher explains.
items.correct: Correct. The order is: fill, make a hole, drop the seed, water.
items.hint: Listen for order words: first, next, then, finally.
items.support: Each signal word marks a new step.
items.extension: Why do you water the seed last?
script: Here is how to plant a seed. First, fill the pot with soil. Next, make a small hole with your finger. Then drop in the seed. Finally, water the soil gently.

items.title: Weather Report Summary
items.prompt: Complete the summary of the weather report.

segments.text: , so hold onto your papers outside.

items.correct: Correct. The morning is sunny and the afternoon turns windy.
items.hint: Listen for the weather word for each part of the day.
items.support: Match the morning and afternoon weather to the blanks.
items.extension: What should you do because it is windy?
script: Here is tomorrow's weather report. The morning will be sunny and bright. In the afternoon it will turn windy, so hold onto your papers when you are outside. Now complete the summary.

items.title: Who Is Speaking?
items.correct: Correct. The clues about seats, seatbelts, and the next stop point to a bus driver.
items.hint: Listen for words about seats, stops, and the road.
items.support: Use the place and tools in the speech to guess the speaker.
items.extension: What other clue could tell you the speaker's job?
script: Please stay in your seats and keep your seatbelts on. Our next stop is the corner of Oak Street, so get ready if that is where you get off.

items.title: Recycling Sort
items.prompt: Listen to each item. Sort it into the right recycling bin.
items.correct: Strong sorting. You matched each item to the correct recycling bin.
items.hint: Listen for what each item is made of.
items.support: Newspaper and notebook pages are paper. Bottles are plastic. Cans are metal.
items.extension: Name one more item for each bin.
listenFor: what each item is made of
script: Listen and sort each item into the right recycling bin. An old newspaper. An empty water bottle. A soda can. A used notebook page. Now place each item in the correct bin.
